name: v06-vs-v1
description: Release A/B: the shipped v0.6 encoder as incumbent against v1's tier ladder. Tier 0 is the equal-budget comparison — both are exactly 32 bytes — and measures what the self-describing descriptor byte cost (v1 spends one fewer luma AC coefficient: LAYOUT_B l_tiers 27 -> 26). Tiers 1-3 are unequal-budget by construction: v0.6 has no ladder, so they measure what the ladder buys, not a like-for-like win. Run with --split holdout for the honest number.
